svg.title: Promodoro
svg.desc: Original task-flow layout and wiring, styled for Moti-Pulse. Start; Choose “Timer”; Select task; Start Time; Pause Time; Resume; Stop; End; Start another Counting; Pomodoro; Sheet containing Goals & Tasks to choose; Pomodoro Tab (Counting); Choose Pomodoro Setting; Pomodoro Setting Sheet; Count down?; Select Focus time; Select Break time; Done; Choose Count up; Pomodoro Setting Sheet (Time intervals disable); Done; Pomodoro Tab (Pause); Pomodoro Tab (Stop); The same task?; The Same Setting?; Find Categories; Categories (Viewing); Done/Back; Select a Categories; Categories (Tasks).
